ac-akcja-disconnect-w-sekcji-remote-proj: UI + remote API: Disconnect action (settings-page ConfirmModal) wired to PATCH /api/config and a downstream release-push first-push path against the remote /v1 API
ac-analyze-ac-against-entities-yje-w-ser: LLM-based: analyze_ac_against_entities is a non-deterministic on-demand semantic audit (ac-tools MCP server) requiring a model — not automatable in Vitest
ac-b-d-operacji-git-brak-gita-w-path-bra: requires git: M28 release git-sync edge cases (no git in PATH / no upstream / detached HEAD / repo gone) exercise real git operations and a UI toast warning — not automatable in Vitest
ac-b-d-po-czenia-pobierania-z-remote-h: remote API + network: --clone CLONE_FAILED rollback depends on a real download failure from the remote /v1 API and full cwd teardown — not automatable in Vitest
ac-belka-akcji-na-acs-z-przyciskiem-anal: UI + chat/agent: /acs action bar 'Analyze consistency' button opens and auto-runs a seeded chat-thread (React + agent run) — not automatable in Vitest
ac-gdy-config-writingstyle-wskazuje-styl: deferred, not not-automatable: the spec (M01/M15) says an unresolvable config.writingStyle hard-fails at SERVER START, while the host validates lazily per project context and deliberately soft-fails (project-context.ts) so one broken value cannot 500 every /api/projects/:id route including the Settings screen needed to fix it. The spec never resolved where that validation runs in a multi-project host, so the message split this AC asks for was held back with it — see the clarification patch filed against brief 0-2-56-to-0-2-57. Remove this entry once the spec answers.
ac-ikona-zebatki-w-prawym-gornym-rogu: UI-only: header gear icon rendering and /settings navigation, not automatable in Vitest
ac-kazdy-komponent-renderowany-poza-kata: spec-document invariant: asserts every out-of-catalog component is DECLARED and justified in its slice's 'Host-local components' field — a property of the specification prose, not of the code. The code-side half (no undeclared twin) is covered by src/client/host-ui-kit/one-implementation.test.ts
ac-kazdy-slice-renderujacy-ui-encji-modu: spec-document invariant: asserts every slice rendering entity UI carries a 'Host UI Kit (L12)' section with 'Components consumed' filled in — a schema requirement on the specification files, with no code artifact to assert against
ac-po-f5-ui-pokazuje-pelna-tresc-trwajac: UI + live agent turn: asserting the browser keeps rendering a turn's content across a mid-turn F5 needs a real turn in flight, which needs a Claude login — ephemeral env-runner environments have none. The server half (replay order, buffer not consumed by a joiner) is covered in src/server/routes/chat.live-join.test.ts
